piezas.titulo: Reading words: Health and everyday symptoms
texto: Reading and spelling of medical terms and leaflets: «ปวด» has the mid-class consonant ป with the central vowel ว and the stop consonant ด (dead syllable, low tone), and «หัว» has the high-class consonant ห (rising tone). «ไข้» has the vowel ไ and the sign ้ over the high-class consonant ข, which produces a falling tone. «พักผ่อน» combines «พัก» (low-class consonant พ, high tone) and «ผ่อน» (high-class consonant ผ with ่, low tone). Reading these words lets you understand leaflets in pharmacies and health notices.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การดื่มน้ำสะอาดและนอนหลับพักผ่อนอย่างเพียงพอช่วยให้ร่างกายฟื้นไข้เร็วขึ้น» express?

opciones.texto: Drinking clean water and resting well speeds up the body's recovery.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การดื่มน้ำสะอาดและนอนหลับพักผ่อนอย่างเพียงพอช่วยให้ร่างกายฟื้นไข้เร็วขึ้น» from the text.

opciones.texto: The pharmacist advises on the dosage and precautions for the medicine.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: If you have a drug reaction or any unusual symptom, go to the doctor at the hospital straight away.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ไข้» (fever), what tone results from the high-class consonant ข with the mark ้ (mái thoo)?

opciones.explicacion: Correct: a high-class consonant with the sign ้ is always pronounced with a falling tone.
Incorrect: in high class, the sign ้ produces a falling tone, not a high one.
Incorrect: a rising tone on high-class consonants occurs without a mark in a live syllable.
